newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle market quiet ahead of USDA data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle market quiet ahead of USDA data.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet early Friday, with no bids or trades reported, feedlot sources said.
Sources said meat packers appear to be awaiting the USDA Cattle-On-Feed Report due at 1400CST/2000GMT Friday. The report should confirm talk of active October placements.
Feedlot managers also were not eager to sell cattle at this week's lower prices. Many of this week's offerings were short fed and could use more days on feed.

Analysts estimate the USDA report will show October placements in the seven primary states in feedlots with 1,000 head or more capacity at 105.7 percent of a year ago. Also, analysts' estimates for November 1 on-feed supplies averaged 99.5 percent of a year ago and October marketing estimates averaged 97.3 percent.
